title: Human Nature Is Good
content_zh:
At the beginning of life, human nature is good. Its nature is similar, but habits make it different. If not taught, its nature will change. The way of teaching is devotion.

In ancient times, Meng Ke's mother chose a neighborhood. Her son did not learn, she broke the shuttle. Dou Yanshan had righteous methods. He taught five sons, each became famous.
